ChessStrategy.org · Chess strategy trainer

Chess strategy training

Free exercises that train what comes before the move: reading the position, choosing a plan, finding good moves and picking the best one. On positions from master games, such as World Championship matches, and from your own Lichess and Chess.com games. Open source, no ads.

  • Imbalance reading: the 3 imbalances that decide the position, and who has the edge.
  • Plan finder: what's urgent, who's better, whether to trade, whether to attack.
  • Candidate moves: find up to 3 strong moves, graded by Stockfish.
  • Move selection: rank four moves, best first.
